The debugger delegate constructs a subkey beneath Windows Image File Execution Options. Its filtered path prepares Debugger, FilterFullPath and UseFilter values; Debugger/FilterFullPath write failures can continue to later writes, while UseFilter failure invokes a cleanup delegate. No native read-back occurs in that wrapper.

The string writer accepts raw type codes 1/2 and computes bytes through a UTF-16 terminator. The underlying writer calls RegCreateKeyExW, RegSetValueExW and RegCloseKey; the value-write status becomes its boolean result and SetLastError value. An access-denied create can retry with raw option 0x4. This observed fallback is not a DCleaner privilege or readiness implementation.

The recursive key helper enumerates index zero repeatedly and tries parent deletion after any nonzero enumeration status; a later delete status can replace that earlier error. Foreign scopes, malformed names, traversal/deeper paths and links refuse.

Existing empty values and absent namespaces retain different catalog encodings. This is not an atomic snapshot, mutation lock, complete member roster or proof that a value belongs to DCleaner.
